preprocessing.description: Preserve source image-name joins, every repeated response row, source global feature z-scoring and source single-trial/noise-ceiling conventions. metric.description: Per voxel, signed Pearson correlation of held-out predictions and observed responses inside each original source fold, followed by equal arithmetic weighting over all 12 folds.
